senses.definition: (US, Canada) A coin worth one-tenth of a dollar, that is, ten cents.

quotes.text: The San Francisco mint made about 2.5 million of these dimes, but fewer than 10 are still known to exist, according to Heritage. That’s because a financial crisis in 1893 killed demand for new coinage, and almost all the dimes were melted down.
quotes.reference: 2016 January 8, Aaron Smith, “This old dime just sold for $2 million”, in CNN:

senses.definition: (Canada, US) A small amount of money.
(slang) A playing card with the rank of ten.

quotes.text: At one point, Rob hit a dire losing streak. In a single week, he dropped a dime—$1,000.
quotes.reference: 2007 05, Ted McClelland, Horseplayers: Life at the Track, Chicago Review Press, →ISBN:

senses.definition: (slang) A measure of illicit drugs (usually marijuana) sold in ten-dollar bags.

quotes.text: These deaths got him a dime in a minimum-security prison.
quotes.reference: 2007 September 23, David Bowman, “Torchlit Crit”, in The New York Times, →ISSN:

examples: Are you traveling on the company's dime?

senses.definition: (US, slang) A beautiful woman (10 on a 10-point scale).

quotes.text: Make a couple of nuns a couple of dimes.
quotes.reference: 2005, “Stay Fly”, in Jordan Houston, Darnell Carlton, Paul Beauregard, Premro Smith, Marlon Goodwin, David Brown, Willie Hutchinson (lyrics), Most Known Unknown, performed by Three 6 Mafia (featuring Young Buck, 8 Ball, and MJG), Sony BMG:

quotes.text: Wait in line for drinks, it’s another time out / Made out on the floor with a couple dimes
quotes.reference: 2008, “House Music”, in Afterparty Babies, performed by Cadence Weapon:

senses.definition: (American football) A defensive formation with six defensive backs, one of whom is a dimeback.
(American football, Canadian football) A particularly long or precise throw that ends with a catch.
(US, slang, with "on") To inform on, to turn in to the authorities, to rat on, especially anonymously.
examples: Somebody dimed on me and I got arrested for selling marijuana.

senses.definition: (US, slang) To operate an audio amplifier (especially an electric guitar amplifier) at level "10" (typically the highest amplification level).
examples: I get the best-sounding sustain and smooth harmonic distortion when I run the amp dimed.
